blends.desc: Can be enchanted to seed magic outside of Ratropia

blends.name: The Impaler (invented by Cigale)
blends.desc: Designed by Cigale for the HEX Corporation, The Impaler was the first LIFESTEAL weapon introduced to the Underpunks RPG. This two-handed GREAT sword is best wielded with 8+ STRENGTH and comes with three special effects. LIFESTEAL: Restores 10% of damage dealt as health (stacks with other Lifesteal items). TITAN'S GRASP: Impossible to disarm if the user has 10+ strength. MARTYR'S PURGE: Lunge forward into a defensive block stance, purging 10% corruption, requires 10+ Strength.

blends.name: Lycanox Hull Ripper - LHR
blends.desc:
Only available to August 2022 (T5) patreon.

Lycanox-forged magnetic harvester for short hardpoints, launching ferro-grapples that latch onto innocent hulls with a 15% proc to shear off metal plating, then electromagnetically welds the scavenged alloys into your vessels framework. Devours pure tungsten as cryogenic wielding rods, torching 2-5 units per cycle from your fab vaults. To a Lycanox its just mining, but to their victims its like being eaten alive.

blends.name: NRG Hull Shield (great)
blends.desc: Heavy-duty hull shield bastion for capital ships. Erects a vast, self-repairing envelope mimicking a Valles Marineris dust storm, shrugging off 128 hits through multi-layered photon deflection. Requires 50 to 100 NRG per hit to automatically repair itself for post-breach stabilisation.

blends.name: NRG Hull Shield (long)
blends.desc: Advanced hull shield array for cruiser-grade defence. Deploys a resonant lattice that harmonises with titanium alloy hulls, enduring 32 weapon impacts via adaptive flux redistribution. Demands 1000 NRG and helium-3 for full recalibration.

blends.name: NRG Hull Shield (short)
blends.desc: Standard-issue hull shield module for frigate mounts. Projects a mid-density energy field, countering enemy fire for 8 hits before overloading. Recharges with 100 NRG and may require the venting of excess heat.

blends.name: NRG Hull Shield (tiny)
blends.desc: Compact hull shield emitter, ideal for corvette hardpoints. Generates a low-yield plasma barrier to deflect incoming projectiles and beams, absorbing up to 1 full weapon hit before depolarizing. Repair via onboard fab with 10 NRG units to restore cohesion.

blends.name: Neutron Irradiator
blends.desc: This Promethean Revenant weapon for long hardpoints, designed by the SkornTech Rebellion, deals damage while consuming RADON and has a chance to induce temporary radiation sickness in enemy crews - reducing their manoeuvrability and firing rate during boarding, though boarding players will require radiation detection and protection. A brutal weapon that tipped the scales in their war against the Martians. Players who dare to use this weapon will gain corruption.

blends.name: Nanite Corroder
blends.desc: This Quantum Nexus device for long hardpoints, deployed by the fabricator rather than functioning as a traditional weapon and designed by R3$1DU4L 4U70M4†, deploys self-replicating bots that slowly convert enemy vessels into its core chassis components - wood, scrap, titanium, or star tar.

blends.name: Salvage Scanner
blends.desc: This Lycanox comms device for short hardpoints, designed by the Sprocketstone Manufacturing Company and operated by the signaller, scans for exotic particle trails left by catastrophic failures - tracing them back to intact derelict cores for easy salvage runs. However, the consuming and releasing of RADON gas will attracts pirates equipped with salvage scanners.

blends.name: Breacher 925
blends.desc: This Promethean Revenant weapon for short hardpoints, designed by the SkornTech Rebellion, consumes hydrogen in the form of deuterium-tritium and has a chance to rip a manhole in the enemy vessel for later EVA boarding if that vessel is also disabled.

blends.name: Photon Disruptor
blends.desc: This Martian weapon, designed by the Red Dawn Dominion for tiny hardpoints, consumes NRG, delivers damage and has a chance to overload enemy sensors - guaranteeing your escape during interdictions, though LYC forces are immune.

blends.name: Neon Jammer
blends.desc: This Promethean Revenant comms device for tiny hardpoints, designed by the SkornTech Rebellion and operated by the signaller rather than a gunner, floods enemy comms with false signals - causing them to see you as friendly, though LYC and PRV forces are immune.

blends.name: Revenger Railgun
blends.desc: This Promethean Revenant weapon for tiny hardpoints, designed by the SkornTech Rebellion, delivers punishing damage while embedding tracking beacons in an enemy's hull - revealing the position of any respawned foes on your vessel's viewscreen for a week, provided you're in the same sector.

blends.name: Precision Laser
blends.desc: This Martian weapon, designed by the Red Dawn Dominion for tiny hardpoints, consumes NRG with a chance to disable an enemy vessel for boarding rather than destroy it.

blends.name: ORK Grasshopper (no skin)
blends.desc:
A cheap bike that unlocks diagonal moement, but will not overcome many hazards and will consume air.

*Designed by "MakerJay" of the Orbital Research Konglomerate, the Grasshopper (ORKG) is a compact, two-wheeled landcraft that enables diagonal movement across planetary grids. Its minimalist design is not only cost-effective but also allows this small bike to be transported within larger vessels. The lightweight chassis and metal frame offer manageable hull strength, repairable with scrap. Despite its fragile hull, the Grasshopper excels in swift travel across larger celestial bodies. However, it lacks an oxyflow module, so a suit with its own air supply is required on planets, moons, and large asteroids with no atmosphere. The ORKG can be upgraded with different coloured SKINS.*

blends.name: Sand Bike
blends.desc:
Because you DO NOT ``!ENTER`` a Sand Bike, it works like a follower you carry with you.
- Think of it as a powered Skateboard.

**MARS**: Sand Bikes will now work on Mars - Badlands Biomes ONLY
* This means foes will block your path as if you are on foot.

BLADES: These are a fragile item that mod and upgrade your Sand Bike.
* **EFFICIENCY:** (cheapest): Reduces fuel consumption, which is advantageous for long-term resource management but has minimal direct impact on immediate race performance.
* **HANDLING:** Counters hazards and attacks. Provides a defensive advantage, which is beneficial but not as aggressive in improving race performance as the other options.
* **SPEED:** Increases average speed. Increases average speed. A solid performance boost, making it more valuable than efficiency and handling, but it's a straightforward enhancement without the extra edge of more specialised mods.
* **TURBO:** Enhances rev speed. This can give a critical advantage in specific moments of the race, like quick accelerations after demise or hazards, allowing you to make up lost time.
* **OVERDRIVE** (most expensive): Experimental mod (all of the above) that combines all the above but with added risk. This mod is the most expensive due to its high reward potential, but it also carries the risk of taking the player out of the race, making it a high-stakes choice.

Each BLADE (in the above order) will cost more coin and require more REP to purchase from the Sand Bandits.

BLADES, being database items, are lost when broken. Only one blade will be used per action, allowing for strategic deployment.

blends.name: SOL Triglave (spacecraft)
blends.desc:
Spacecraft upgrade...

**INGREDIENTS**
3 x SOL Vanguard
1 x MFKR

**RESULT**
The Solstice Triglave (SOLT) is a two-man Martian fighter vessel built more for ostentatious intimidation than functionality. Equipped with 3 tiny hardpoints, 3 short hardpoints, 2 long hardpoints but no storage, its mobility thrusters and engines are optimised for lift-off and space travel. The short chassis and advanced frame provide a solid hull strength of 80, requiring Titanium for repairs. This agile ship is perfect for two-player combat missions and may be crafted by BLENDING 3 x SOLV ships with 1 x MFKR (Modular Fusion Kinetic Regenerator). The Triglave is highly sought after due to its special REGEN ability (radial movement +1 hp, orbital movement +4 hp) as long as you have titanium on hand.

UNSKINNED VERSION
This SOLT vessel can have SKINS applied to customise its look.

blends.name: Volna-57 Geiger Counter
blends.desc:
1 per player MAX
- Please do not use alt account to purchase muliples.

This TOOL will mostly be used for !JOBS and for the SCIENTIST path.

*The Volna-57, produced by the Soviet manufacturer Radiosfera in 1957, was a rugged, tube-based Geiger counter designed for military and scientific use, featuring a bakelite casing and a distinctive red needle gauge. Its hand-cranked dynamo makes it a reliable tool for extended field operations, ensuring functionality in remote environments without dependence on external power sources.*

blends.desc:
A great vessel for exploring mars in the biggest simulated world on WAX.

Invented by the player, "Lalothen."

Designed by "Lalothen" for the Ratropian Tinkerers' Syndicate, the Squeakster (RTSS) is an all-terrain landcraft featuring six wheels for superior mobility. It comes equipped with two "tiny" Hardpoints, perfect for customising with your choice of weapons or tech. The vehicle includes four "tiny" storage compartments to securely hold your resources. While the stabilising wing adds a +2 to the coolness factor, it's just for show. The "tiny" chassis and "metal" frame yield a modest Hull strength of 4, which can be repaired using Scrap. Despite its frail hull, the Squeakster is shielded with radiation ablatives, ensuring safety on planets lacking a protective magnetosphere.

You will need a supply of **OIL** (fuel) and **SCRAP** (repair) to operate this vessel.

- Increase the amount of resources you can mine and collect

It fires SCRAP ammunition, offering low damage with a high rate of fire and variability, including a chance of jamming that's easily fixed with a wrench. blends.name: Champion of the Homeless Medal
blends.desc:
Dear citizens of Ratropia,

I implore you to lend me your ear and heed my call for aid. For it is with a heavy heart that I must draw your attention to the dire plight of the homeless children who roam the dark, dangerous and dusty streets of our underground world. These innocent young rats are bereft of the basic necessities of life, with nowhere to lay their heads, nought to feed their empty bellies and no one to care for them.

It is for this reason that I, Ms. Cordelia Fluffermuffet, have taken it upon myself to launch the Rat-a-tat-tat-fund, with the goal of building an orphanage to provide these poor souls with a roof over their heads, sustenance to feed their bodies, and education to enrich their minds.

We require the assistance of all kindly souls in the form of shrooms, coins and stone blocks to construct this most worthy endeavor. Furthermore, we seek the generosity of a shire owner to donate land and coin of the highest bid, to take naming rights on this most noble institution and to hold a seat on its board.

The costs of this endeavor are great, but the rewards of giving these children a new lease on life are beyond measure. I implore you, dear citizens, to contribute what you may, so that together we may achieve our aim and bring a brighter future to the unfortunate young rats of Ratropia.

Yours sincerely,
Ms. Cordelia Fluffermuffet.

* SHARDLIGHT depth fishing spots require a Green Fishing Pole with a chance of catching a MegaBytes. At this depth shard light still works. *Small tackle.*
* MIDNIGHT depth fishing spots require a Blue Fishing Pole with a chance of catching a GigaBytes. At this depth shard light doesn't work. *Medium tackle.*
* ABYSS depth fishing spots require a Red Fishing Pole with a chance of catching a TeraBytes. *Medium tackle.*
* TRENCH depth fishing spots require a White Fishing Pole with a chance of catching a PetaBytes. *Large tackle.*
* CORRUPTED depth fishing spots require a Black Fishing Pole with a chance of catching a ExaBytes. *Large tackle.*

blends.name: FAK-32
blends.desc:
NPC: **Snake Crispin**
Snake is a gruff, thick-skinned rat who enjoys upgrading first aid kits, manufacturing Silver Jewellery, and slaughtering his opponents with philosophical pessimism.

**FAK-32**
This is a portable First Aid Kit that you can bring into map and combat rooms. The FAK-32 removes 20 to 32 damage and is mostly used to heal others. Before this item can heal at its maximum capacity, the player must have 3 MEDICINE skill.

MEDICINE >= 3 heals 32 damage. 
MEDICINE >= 2 heals 28 damage.
